marta_cs: quick pulse on Oakridge — weekly token + throughput check-in

marta_cs: TLDR: tokens -3% WoW, +9% QoQ; avg throughput 420 rps; p95 latency 170ms (+30ms WoW); error rate 0.45% (spike Tue); spend +8% WoW. flagged for light enablement followup. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

marta_cs: metrics snapshot -> dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/oakridge/token-flow (links ok for reference)

marta_cs: quick table (7d window):
```
7d tokens: 1.08M  (-3% WoW, +9% QoQ)
avg throughput: 420 rps
p95 latency: 170ms (prev 140ms)
errors: 0.45% (Tue 1.8% spike between 02:10-02:25 UTC)
weekly spend: $6.4k (+8% WoW)
```

jamal_eng: saw the Tue spike in SRE alerts — most were 502s back from the routing layer, correlates with autoscaling jitter
jamal_eng: digging into logs now, looks like a short KV cache warm-up causing backend to fall back to cold model (higher latency + errors)

oliver_se: FYI I ran an enablement session last week; Oakridge started using longer system prompts which increases tokens per call by ~12% — could explain spend bump

marta_cs: good call. so combined effects: longer prompts + occasional cold model fallback = higher p95 and spend

tina_csm: renewal risk check: usage still within committed tier but margin narrowing. recommend outreach to discuss batching suggestions and prompt length tradeoffs this week. tagging @account-owner for next steps

leo_fin: finance note — if trend continues, estimated monthly overage of ~$1.2k without batching/quantization changes

jamal_eng: action items: 1) infra — investigate autoscaler backoff thresholds, 2) runtime — enable more aggressive KV prewarming for Oakridge model variant, 3) cs — run prompt/response audit with customer to reduce unnecessary token inflation

marta_cs: assigning: @jamal_eng (infra), @jamal_eng (runtime) — can you estimate ETA? @tina_csm will coordinate customer audit.

jamal_eng: infra triage complete, I can deploy autoscaler tweak by EOD tomorrow; runtime prewarm requires a small flag change and can be staged in dev today, prod by Thu

tina_csm: scheduling audit call with Oakridge for Thu 16:00 PT — will prep sample prompts and guidance doc. will also offer a quick training on batching usage in SDKs

marta_cs: great. I'll update the weekly health deck and mark renewal risk as "monitoring" (not yet at-risk). will follow up next sync with updated metrics. :white_check_mark:

monitor-bot: Incident alert resolved: routing-layer-502s — 2026-02-10T02:28:41Z — root cause autoscaler cascade mitigated

marta_cs: thanks all. notes and action items in ticket: https://redwood.app/tickets/CS-4981 — feel free to add logs or QA notes there.

leo_fin: ping me if you want me to model spend scenarios for the next quarter.

marta_cs: will do — end of thread.
